verdict.rationale: LM Studio's own CLI documents `lms load` with explicit `--gpu=max|auto|0.0-1.0` and `--context-length=1-N` flags. That directly lets a developer load a model with custom GPU offload and context length from the command line. missing for 10: in-depth documentation of flag behavior and defaults beyond the syntax line, independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI load flags.

support.subject: As a developer, I can load a model with custom GPU offload and context length settings from the command line
